notes: Flashcards, rebuilt: open a set and you're studying it. Each set has five ways to study: Flashcards, Learn, Write, Test and Match. Edit is its own button, with every term and definition editable right on the page.
Notebooks write like a real document: text sizes, bold, italic, underline, colors, highlights, checklists, quotes and links, with Markdown shortcuts as you type.
Every class has its own Notebook and Tutor tabs, so you can take notes and ask questions without leaving the class.
Today's Schedule shows your day on a timeline, like the schedule editor, with a week strip to jump between days.
The calendar has a Day view and a cleaner month. Drag a block to move it, or pull its bottom edge to change how long it is.
Liquid Glass for iPhone, iPad and Mac, in Settings › Look. It follows your device's light or dark mode, contrast and text size.
